title: Make task ranking offset-aware like byCreatedAtThenId
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: `byPriorityThenCreatedAtThenId` (src/core/tasks.ts:64-73) compares `created_at` as plain strings, while `byCreatedAtThenId` (src/core/time.ts:56-64) is offset-aware via `Date.parse`. On a shared ledger authored across machines with different timezone offsets (e.g. +02:00 vs +03:00), lexical comparison mis-orders records whose instants differ only by the offset. Align the ADR-0008 comparator with the offset-aware parsing used elsewhere, keeping the missing-`created_at`-sorts-earliest and `id` tiebreak semantics.
acceptance: `byPriorityThenCreatedAtThenId` orders equal-priority tasks by real instant (offset-aware), matching `byCreatedAtThenId` semantics.
Missing `created_at` still sorts earliest; `id` remains the final tiebreak (ADR-0008).
Tests cover equal-priority tasks with differing timezone offsets in `created_at`.
Index-backed ordering (`readyFromIndex`) agrees with in-memory ordering for the same records.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
